title: Recover or explicitly settle an ordinary prompt superseded by a Stop that later fails
outcome: Define and validate recovery for a non-Engram prompt whose final handoff returned Superseded during pending Stop when that same Stop later fails. Avoid an orphaned Active turn or silently lost proven-unsent prompt while preserving exact ownership, operator pause and the prohibition on replay after uncertain provider acceptance.
acceptance: Recover or explicitly settle an ordinary prompt superseded by a Stop that later fails is done
